About.title: Explore Sri Lanka with your hands free.
About.intro: Luggo connects travellers with luggage storage hubs in Sri Lanka. Whether you are waiting to check in, heading out after checkout, or stopping between journeys, you can find a place to leave your bags while you explore.

find.title: Find a hub
find.text: Browse available hubs and check opening hours, bag sizes, and prices before booking.

drop.title: Drop off your bags
drop.text: Show your booking at the hub. Staff record your bags and their security seals at check-in.

collect.title: Collect when ready
collect.text: Return within your booked time and the hub's opening hours. Use your booking reference to collect your bags.

About.knowText: Availability and pricing depend on the hub and your storage duration. Review your booking details, the <terms>Terms of Service</terms>, and our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> before booking.
About.contactText: For questions about Luggo or working with us, email <email></email>.

Pricing.title: Simple, hourly rates
Pricing.note: These are our lowest rates across all hubs. Exact pricing is confirmed at checkout for your chosen hub.

how.a: Find a hub on the map, book online in seconds, and drop your bags at the counter. Staff seal them with a tamper-proof tag and photograph the seal before you leave. Pick up whenever you're ready, up to closing time.

late.q: What if I'm running late to pick up my bags?
late.a: You get a 15-minute grace period after your booked pickup time at no extra charge. After that, storage is billed in 30-minute blocks at your hub's rate, capped at the daily rate, so a short delay never costs more than a day would.

covered.q: What's covered if something happens to my bags?
covered.a: Every hub is vetted, and your bags are sealed and photographed at drop-off. You can also add Luggo Guarantee for LKR 150 per bag, with compensation up to {amount} per booking for eligible accidental damage, loss, or theft while stored, subject to the Terms of Service.

account.q: Do I need to create an account or pay upfront?
account.a: No. You can book as a guest and pay by card online, or reserve now and pay cash at the counter when you drop off. An account just makes it faster to book again and manage extensions.
